$comment: Baseline of the three-arm rebound pilot (tools/export_rebound.py --manifest): arm B = the model with VP but without the operators of step 8 (vp_run names the VP run used, vp_runs maps run names to directories, every reference carries its VP run and claim), arm C = the model alone (references carry an identifier only). Arm A is a Frontier working directory (rebound.json). parent_idea and T must be those of arm A's intake.json; generated_utc must be later than the researcher's notes. The three arms are exported in one anonymised format; prior art is NOT part of a baseline (it is evaluated apart, by one procedure for the three arms).
